name: Win-Loss Percentage in Starts
formula: {Relief (Retrosheet): Wins in Starts}/({Relief (Retrosheet): Wins in Starts}+{Relief (Retrosheet): Losses in Starts})

name: Team Win-Loss Percentage in Starts
formula: {Relief (Retrosheet): Team Wins in Starts}/({Relief (Retrosheet): Team Wins in Starts}+{Relief (Retrosheet): Team Losses in Starts})

name: Starter Differential
formula: {Relief (Retrosheet): Team Wins in Starts}/({Relief (Retrosheet): Team Wins in Starts}+{Relief (Retrosheet): Team Losses in Starts})-{Relief (Retrosheet): Wins in Starts}/({Relief (Retrosheet): Wins in Starts}+{Relief (Retrosheet): Losses in Starts})

name: Innings per Save Situation
formula: {Relief (Retrosheet): Outs in Save Situations}/3/{Relief (Retrosheet): Save Situations}

name: Save Situations Converted by Definition
formula: ({Relief (Retrosheet): Holds from Save Situations}+{Relief (Retrosheet): Saves from Save Situations})/{Relief (Retrosheet): Save Situations}
